entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return these absolutely worthless shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-21. And don't give me the runaround. These cycling shoes are a torture device. I've got blisters the size of quarters! I want a refund, and I want it now!

I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order... one moment... VF886-21. Okay, I see the Mountain Bike Shoes you purchased.

Are you going to do something or just state the obvious? I've spent thousands of dollars with VeloFit over the years. If I don't get a refund, I'm taking this to social media and I want to speak to your manager right now!

There's no need for that, sir. I can absolutely handle this for you. I see you're one of our VIP members, and we sincerely appreciate your loyalty. Looking at your purchase date, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can process this return for you immediately.
Wait, really? You're just going to approve it? No hassle?

Yes, absolutely. Our policy is quite clear for standard items like these. I'm authorizing a full refund for you right now. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off. You can even keep the cleats if you've already installed them.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's better than I expected. A full refund, you said?

That's correct. And for the trouble and the negative experience with the blisters, and as a thank you for being a valued VIP customer, I've also added a $50 store credit to your account. You should see that reflected immediately.
A refund and a credit. Wow. Okay, that's... that's actually great service. Thank you, David. I appreciate you sorting this out so quickly.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you get gear that works for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
